Sporty people use the landing lanes for kite-boarding, skating and bike-riding. An urban gardening community turned part of the airport into a unique blossoming garden.
Two busy streets form the backbone of Neukölln, Karl-Marx-Str. and Hermannstr., both full of bustling cheap shops and eateries. The more cooler sites lay in the backstreets like Weserstr., Herrfurthplatz in the Shillerkietz, nearby Emser Str. or little father Kreuzberg and the so called Kreuzkölln, along many others.

Nestled in the heart of Berlin, Charlottenburg is a district renowned for its blend of cultural richness and modern sophistication.

At the forefront of its allure is the Kurfürstendamm, often referred to as 'Ku'damm.' This bustling boulevard is a paradise for shoppers and culture enthusiasts alike, lined with high-end boutiques, historic theaters, and inviting cafes.

Not far from this vibrant avenue is the Berlin Zoological Garden, one of the world's most visited zoos, offering an enchanting escape to nature and a chance to explore an impressive biodiversity.

Dominating the district's historical landscape is the majestic Schloss Charlottenburg. This baroque palace, with its splendid gardens, serves as a testament to the city's royal past, offering visitors a glimpse into the opulence and artistry of a bygone era. Charlottenburg, with its dynamic blend of history, culture, and urban vibrancy, presents a microcosm of Berlin's unique charm.
